arguments.communicationGoal: Separate competitive position from competitive momentum.

proposition.headlineIntent: Northstar still owns the strongest position; Pulse owns the momentum.
proposition.dekIntent: Current scale and direction of travel are different strategic questions.

analyticalRelationship.description: Compare W5 total-sample consideration with change from W2 to W5 for each brand.

primary.role: position and momentum for five brands

requiredUniverseNotes: Total eligible sample; unaware respondents count as not considering; weighted

visualForm.rationale: The board needs to see simultaneously who is large and who is moving; five time-series panels obscure that distinction.

alternativesRejected.reason: Five lines prioritise chronology over the strategic position/momentum comparison.
Creates excessive equal visual weight across brands.

hierarchy.dominantElement: Pulse's positive momentum relative to its current mid-tier position

commentary.intent: Position and momentum are different: Northstar remains largest while Pulse has changed most.

qualityChecks: Axes and derived measures use the same approved weighted universe
No visual implication that momentum equals market size

arguments.communicationGoal: Show that Northstar's external market presence and customer experience moved differently.

proposition.headlineIntent: Northstar still looks healthy from the outside. Its customers tell a different story.
proposition.dekIntent: Awareness remains intact while advocacy, problems and reliability deteriorate among customers/familiar consumers.

analyticalRelationship.description: Juxtapose stable total-market awareness with W4 deterioration in customer/familiar-brand experience measures.
analyticalRelationship.comparisonFrame: External market presence vs customer experience

visualForm.rationale: The argument is a divergence between different universes, not a common-scale time series. Juxtaposition preserves that distinction.

alternativesRejected.reason: Overlaying awareness and NPS would imply a common scale and universe.
Independent bars would lose the before/after shock and divergence.

commentary.intent: The immediate vulnerability is customer-led; market visibility has not yet absorbed the shock.

notes: Universe labels must be adjacent to measures.

qualityChecks: Never place awareness and NPS on a shared numeric axis
W4 event annotation does not imply unsupported downstream causality
